say.en: A boss says 'go'; a leader says 'let us go'. People follow a leader willingly, not only because of a designation. In this lesson: Define leadership and explain its importance.
List qualities of a good leader.
Compare autocratic, democratic and laissez-faire styles.

body.en: *Leadership* is the process of influencing the behaviour of people to make them strive voluntarily towards achieving organisational goals. It indicates the ability to influence others, brings change in their behaviour, shows interpersonal relations between leader and followers, and is a continuous process. A leader influences people to contribute positively, maintains personal relations, introduces changes, handles conflicts and trains subordinates.

narration.en: Leadership is influencing people to work willingly for group goals. There are three styles.

say.en: Leadership is influencing people to work willingly for group goals. There are three styles.
Autocratic: the leader gives orders, communication is one way.
Democratic: the leader and the group decide together; communication is two way.
Laissez-faire: the group decides on its own; the leader only supports.
Use autocratic in emergencies, democratic with skilled staff, and free rein with self-driven experts.

body.en: Autocratic leaders give orders and expect them to be obeyed; communication is one way. Democratic or participative leaders develop action plans together with subordinates and encourage them to participate. Laissez-faire or free-rein leaders give subordinates a high degree of independence and only support them; the group makes its own decisions.
body.kn: ನಿರಂಕುಶ ನಾಯಕ ಆದೇಶ ನೀಡಿ ಪಾಲನೆ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಪ್ರಜಾಸತ್ತಾತ್ಮಕ ನಾಯಕ ಅಧೀನರ ಜೊತೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಮುಕ್ತ ನಾಯಕ ಗುಂಪಿಗೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.

problem.en: A research lab head tells a team of experienced scientists: 'Here is the goal; choose your own methods and come to me if you need resources.' Identify the leadership style.

steps.en: The leader sets only the goal and gives full freedom in methods and decisions.
The leader's role is only to support and supply resources.
This is free-rein leadership, suited to highly competent people.
